dedupe_keys.name: airport solar pv implementation guidance document aci asia pacific 2023

description: The Airport Solar PV Implementation Guidance Document, published in 2023 by Airports Council International (ACI) Asia-Pacific and drafted by its Regional Environment Committee under the lead of Delhi International Airport and Malaysia Airports, explains how airports can develop solar photovoltaic plants. Contents: eight project tasks (demand estimation, site selection, technology and plant design, financial viability, developer selection, construction, commissioning, and operation and maintenance), aviation-specific issues such as glare and operational safety, end-of-life of panels, Solargis maps of photovoltaic potential for Asia and Australia-Pacific, and case studies of Adelaide, Darwin, Delhi, Kuala Lumpur and Sharjah. A table of installation parameters gives, for example, 14 MWp of rooftop and car park canopy arrays at Kuala Lumpur supplying about 18,000 MWh of a 405,000 MWh demand, and 7.84 MWp ground-mounted airside at Delhi with a 78% performance ratio. Format and access: a free 76-page PDF. Licence and cost: free to read but all rights reserved. Caveats: a guidance document with a handful of airports, not a complete inventory, and figures are self-reported. The site and yield figures can set on-site generation potential for airport energy supply and backup in capacity planning and optimisation models. It relates to the Global Solar Atlas and PVGIS in the catalogue.
